citation.authors: Gammal RS, Pirmohamed M, Somogyi AA, Morris SA et al

cited_by.title: G6PD deficiency: who carries it and what to avoid

record.population: Medicines previously implicated as unsafe in G6PD deficiency
record.design: Guideline based on a systematic review of gene-drug evidence and regulatory warnings
record.finding: Medications are classed high, medium or low-to-no risk. High-risk drugs should be avoided, medium-risk drugs used with caution, and low-to-no-risk drugs given with standard precautions. The guideline replaces the earlier rasburicase guideline.
record.note: Abstract read; the drug table itself was not opened, so no drug is placed in a risk class on this card.
